'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|About time you stopped by. You've noticed those night devils coming out of everywhere too, haven't you? They're arming themselves a lot better, huh. It's like someone's actually working with them. From above, you know? We should look into what those bastards are up to. Besides, all the better if you can reduce their numbers. Just be careful. There's a rumor among the scavengers that you can run into an invincible beast at night. They say it hunts and devours humans. I remember an Eastern story about such a demon, its nickname was, uh... "The Oni". I wouldn't have brought these stories up before. But now something's definitely brewing, and dark thoughts just keep creeping into my head.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 5 [[Cultists|hooded night people]]

==Rewards==
* +12,500 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 50,000 Roubles
** 52,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 57,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Cult Locust ballistic plate]]
* 1× [[Cult Termite ballistic plate]]
* 1× [[L3Harris GPNVG-18 night vision goggles]]
* 1× [[Dorm room 314 marked key]]
{{quote|So, what'd you find? I didn't sit idle either while you were gone, I met with Partisan. He says they're preparing a special ritual, and that's why they're coming out of their dens. They're all mentioning some kind of "Night of The Cult". I don't know what's this about, but it's definitely bad news for Tarkov. And something tells me there's somebody who's orchestrating the whole thing. That demon didn't just show up in our parts for no reason. I saw something myself last night, though. His face was red, like it was burning. I grabbed my gun and aimed, but just as I blinked, there was no one there. Old man hallucinations, perhaps...}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 5 [[Cultists]].
